trigger: ledger seq 77 (scope_limit): the density-only SiC contrast nearly vanishes at x = 0.3 (host density 3.23 g/cm3 vs SiC 3.21; contrast 2.8e-5 against 9.3e-3 at x = 0.2). If density mismatch is what makes SiC scatter, the recipe pick moves to x = 0.5, R = 2.5 nm; if SiC also scatters through stiffness and interface strain, the x = 0.2 calibration carries over and the pick stays x = 0.3, R = 5 nm. The previous MD check calibrated only x = 0.2.
question: Does an embedded SiC particle still lower kappa in a Si0.7Ge0.3 host whose mass density equals that of SiC, and by how much relative to the same particle in Si0.8Ge0.2?

method.engine: identical to md_design.json (ledger seq 58): LAMMPS, Tersoff 1989 + inert Ge-C triplets, Muller-Plathe rNEMD, NPT 50 ps, warm 100 ps, production 500 ps, swap every 50 steps, 20 z-bins, 12 x 12 x 40 cells
method.only_change: -var x 0.3 (host composition); in.sic_particle, potential file and analyze_mp.py are byte-identical copies of ../md/
method.runs: points.txt: host (2 seeds); R = 15 and 20 A: shell-only control and particle, 2 seeds each; 10 runs, T = 300 K. R = 10 A is dropped: at x = 0.2 its two seeds disagreed by a factor 2.5 (0.11 vs 0.04)
method.reference: x = 0.2 runs of ledger seq 59 (../md/results), same seeds, same radii
method.placement: notchpeak-guest / owner-guest, 32 ranks, requeue; grn061 and the DGX are not used

gates.G1: as seq 58: Ge-to-centre minus C-to-centre gap >= 5.7 A at start and end of every particle run
gates.G2: every run gives a finite positive kappa
gates.G3: mean C coordination at the end >= 3.3
gates.G4: the two host seeds agree within 8%

analysis.reduction: r(x, R) = 1 - kappa(particle) / kappa(shell-only), seed-paired; mean and two-seed half range
analysis.ratio: rho = mean over R in {15, 20} A of r(0.3, R) / r(0.2, R), each r a two-seed mean

predictions.PrX1: r(0.3, 20 A) >= 0.10 (SiC still scatters when the density contrast vanishes)
predictions.PrX2: mean host kappa at x = 0.3 is below the x = 0.2 host mean (1.094 W/mK)

decision_rule.density_tracks: rho < 0.25: the density contrast is the mechanism; the per-x density pick of seq 77 (x = 0.5, 3 at% C, R = 2.5 nm) is supported; correct operation replaces the pick and lifts the seq-77 scope limit
decision_rule.insensitive: rho >= 0.75: SiC scatters through stiffness or interface strain, so the x = 0.2 calibration carries to other compositions; the pick x = 0.3, 3 at% C, R = 5 nm is restored by a correct operation and the seq-77 scope limit is lifted
decision_rule.intermediate: 0.25 <= rho < 0.75: the seq-77 scope limit (x = 0.3 to 0.5) stays; rho is recorded as the measured fraction of the x = 0.2 scattering retained at density match
decision_rule.gates_fail: if any gate fails, the run is reported and the decision is taken only if the rho branch is the same with and without the failing run; otherwise the scope limit stays
decision_rule.not_affected: the 27 to 33% Ge-saving claim (matches at x <= 0.15) is outside this question and no branch changes it
